reason: I'd try the free tricks at Friday dinner, but I won't put my card into some website for an app that isn't in the App Store when I can't find real performance videos, reviews or a known magician behind it. 99 shekels isn't the issue. I just don't know who these people are.
objection: Will the reveal actually look real? If the fake call or the 'old' note looks a bit off, or there's an awkward setup step, my family will see it straight away. On top of that it's a browser-installed app with card payment and no store review behind it.
would_change_my_mind: Uncut videos of the tricks fooling real people, plus reviews from Israeli magicians I recognise and a named creator, and the free tricks actually fooling my family on Friday.
